## Summary
PrintWeek coverage of the Infigo rebrand — the moment "Catfish" the platform name was retired in favor of consolidating everything under the "Infigo" brand. Page returned thin JS shell on fetch; content reconstructed from web searches. Useful primarily for explaining old vs. new naming in legacy docs.

## Key takeaways
- The Infigo platform was historically marketed as "Catfish" — many older third-party reviews (Capterra, GetApp, SoftwareAdvice) still index as "Catfish."
- Rebrand consolidated the family (Catfish + MegaEdit + Symphony + Hybrid Mail) under the single Infigo umbrella.
- Marketing investment signal — paired with growth claims and US-market push.
- **Why it matters:** When reading old reviews/docs that say "Catfish," they're referring to today's "Infigo" core product. Same software, just renamed.
- **Caveat:** Page returned a JS shell on direct fetch. Use cross-references to Capterra, GetApp, SoftwareAdvice profile (all still URL-slugged "/Catfish/") to confirm the rename timeline.
